reason: On our pension I only put paint on my walls from a brand I have seen on TV, and I ask for it by name. I have never heard of Turbolux, and ₹78,000 is too much money to try out a brand I don't know.
objection: They say one fixed price, but then the site visit 'confirms what will be painted'. I worry that once they see the damp patches after the monsoon, the scope gets cut or extra charges get added, and I have no big name to complain to.
would_change_my_mind: A written promise that ₹78,000 is the final bill whatever the site visit finds, plus a 2BHK they painted in Kochi that I can go and see myself, a few monsoons old and still not peeling.
